item.title: 2026-09-06 「开源之道」·论文略读：开源软件对 GDP 的影响及其与研发、专利的互补性 — Knut Blind & Torben Schubert
item.description: Blind & Schubert (2023) 用 32 国 × 19 年的跨国面板数据首次量化开源对 GDP 的净影响：本国贡献因知识溢出而扣减国内 GDP（-2.7%），但全球 OSS 存量提升所有国家 GDP（+4.9%），净效应 +2.2%——开源第一次被作为『生产要素』而非『文化理想』纳入宏观经济学计量。这是 Nagle $8.8T 估值论文的国家层面互补，也是新制度经济学『公共知识池』命题第一次在面板数据上被严格验证。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-09-06
item.description: "MIIT's office issued the AI SME Startup Support Plan 2026-2028 on September 4, 2026 — a 15-item three-year programme that makes five institutionally new moves on the same unsolved object as the prior four briefings (Ren Xudong's governance-layer-deficit essay on September 5; CAC's Qinglang Phase 2 on September 3; Chongqing's 15th-Five-Year-Plan on September 2; COPU's KubeCon address on September 2): (1) Item 9 formally names AtomGit as 'national-level AI open-source community' (国家级人工智能开源社区), the first administrative-document designation of AtomGit at the national-community level and a structural confirmation of AtomGit's role as the institutional anchor of China's open-weight release apparatus; (2) Item 4 explicitly names 'open-source community core contributors' as a new entrepreneurial subject with an encouraged commercialization path — the first administrative recognition that open-source contribution itself is an entrepreneurial subject class in China; (3) Item 13 introduces compute-equity and data-equity arrangements (算力入股、数据入股), an institutional innovation that treats compute and data as equity inputs into SME ventures rather than market-priced factor inputs; (4) Item 4 also explicitly names 'one-person companies / super individuals' (一人公司 / 超级个体) as an encouraged entrepreneurial subject — a structurally new administrative recognition of the individual contributor as an SME-form object; (5) the evaluation-metrics clause (last paragraph) explicitly names open-source project star counts as one of four official performance indicators for identifying high-growth-potential AI SMEs — the first administrative-document use of the GitHub-style star metric as an institutional evaluation metric in China."

item.title: 2026-09-05 「开源之道」·荐书：思想的力量 — 科尔奈
item.description: 科尔奈（1998 诺奖）用一本『非常规自传』回答一个更根本的问题：一个社会学家/经济学家的信念如何被制度反复塑造、如何崩塌、如何被一种『保持移动』的方式重新接住——Keep Movement 是适兕开源之道的方法论原型，来自这本书。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-09-05
item.description: "Huawei's Chief Open-Source Strategy Officer Ren Xudong (任旭东) publishes in Silicon Time (硅基时间) the first systematic institutional-framework essay from a Chinese vendor official on AI open-source governance — a four-layer openness taxonomy (open interface / open weights / open training / open governance), a three-layer competition model (model / runtime / governance), and an explicit claim that China's most dangerous open-source weakness is at the governance layer, where Chinese participation in AAIF, MCP, and Open VSX is nearly absent; a four-layer Chinese policy recommendation (strategy / mechanism / ecosystem / governance) is offered as a systematic proposal, and the essay is the first documented instance of a Huawei official positioning Chinese open source not as model-cost-advantage but as an institutional-governance deficit that requires a Chinese-seat strategy at neutral Western foundations."

item.title: 2026-09-04 「开源之道」·荐书：与时俱进的启蒙 — 徐贲
item.description: 徐贲用『框架误导（misframing）』概念解释为什么中国开源『只看到技术、没看到制度』——同一个 GitHub，梁启超的『国家富强』框与托克维尔的『民主』框得出完全不同结论；开源的『出海』讨论，被一个行政修辞框架遮蔽了它真正的制度含义。

item.title: 2026-09-04 「开源之道」·论文略读：Bernstein — 为 AI Agent 打造的确定性开源治理层 — Alex Chernysh
item.description: Bernstein（Chernysh 2026, Zenodo）把『可复现构建』原则从代码层扩展到 Agent 编排层：协调环中不用任何模型，昨天的计划回放产生逐字节相同的任务图，每一步携带签名谱系——这是 Ostrom『监测』原则的极致化，也是 AI Agent 时代『行动的定义权』第一次有了可操作的工程答案。

item.title: 2026-09-03 「开源之道」·荐书：The Great Chain of Being — Arthur O. Lovejoy
item.description: 开源社区有一条从 Creator 到 Maintainer 再到 Committer 的'存在巨链'——理解它，才理解开源治理改革的难度。

item.title: 2026-09-02 「开源之道」·论文略读：收入反馈制度范式 — Pacheco, Garrido & Fernández Domingos
item.description: Pacheco, Garrido & Fernández Domingos (2026, J. R. Soc. Interface 23(241):20260508) 用集体风险困境（CRD）博弈论框架，把『全球风险公地治理的资金从哪来』从会计问题升格为制度经济学问题，提出『收入反馈』（revenue-feedback, RF）范式：制度从自身运行中内生地生成资源并实施奖惩，而非依赖外部拨款。本文从适兕反复强调的『大分流 2.0』视角追问：开源基金会是 RF 范式的天然实证，而行政拨款驱动的治理则是其结构性反面——什么条件下治理制度能内生出自身资源，是制度变迁的关键观察点。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-09-02
item.description: "COPU's September 1 weekly meeting minutes, co-signed by Lu Shouqun (陆首群, acting in his first COPU-named role as honorary chairman) and Jiang Tao (蒋涛), document two institutional moves on the open-weight layer in a single sitting: (1) Lu Shouqun's first address to a Western foundation — KubeCon China 2026 (September 7–9, Shanghai International Convention Center, co-located with OpenInfra Summit + PyTorch Conference, per Linux Foundation's June 19 press release) — is drafted with a three-axis framework (performance / cost-reduction / invocation) and a '50-vs-2' open-weight framing, explicitly casting the 50 founding members of WAICO as a majority vote against Anthropic and AWS on the open-weights question; (2) Jiang Tao's essay 'Chinese large models are world-class' is attached in full to the COPU minutes, publishing its four-account-book framework and eight-layer architecture in a COPU-branded institutional surface — a structurally new placement that the prior Silicon Time briefing (August 31) did not document. In parallel, Chongqing's 15th-Five-Year-Plan AI framework, analyzed by the Tiangong Kaiwu Open Source Foundation (天工开物开源基金会), is the first city-level 15th-Five-Year-Plan AI plan to elevate 'open source' from a technical option to an explicitly named 'industrial infrastructure' and 'organizational form of industrial ecology' — alongside explicit clauses on 'open-source-safety testing, supply-chain maturity assessment, and supply-chain-break risk prevention', making Chongqing the first municipal plan in which open-source infrastructure and compliance are codified in the same document."

item.title: 2026-09-01 「开源之道」·论文略读：多主体开源社区知识产权协同治理的演化策略 — Hu, Deng & Qi
item.description: 胡健、邓渝婷、祁勇 (2025, Economics of Innovation and New Technology, DOI 10.1080/10438599.2025.2458283) 用演化博弈模型刻画开源社区基金会、社区运营商、贡献者三方在知识产权治理上的策略演化，以『数字技术创新』为核心外生变量，得出初始意愿、奖惩机制、贡献成本、侵权风险四类参数对策略均衡的显著影响。论文的价值不在于具体结论，而在于它是 Coase 产权定理 × Williamson 治理结构 × Nelson & Winter 演化制度主义在开源中国语境中的一次系统性实证。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-09-01
item.description: "Moonshot AI closes a $3.5B round at a $35B valuation — tripled in six months — with China's National AI Industry Investment Fund as anchor, before reaching out for a new round at a $50B pre-money valuation ahead of a Hong Kong IPO; Reuters reports DeepSeek is planning a fresh raise at ~$74B valuation ahead of a mainland IPO, with the same National AI Industry Investment Fund negotiating to become lead investor — meaning China's two largest frontier labs are being consolidated with state-directed capital at a combined valuation approaching $85B, an industrial-policy consolidation rather than competitive-market dynamics; a separate institutional layer — the tiered-governance apparatus for open-weight models (Beijing MoC + NDRC meetings with Alibaba/ByteDance/Z.ai documented by Reuters July 7; formalized by a May Supreme People's Court roundtable summary; analyzed by Jamestown August 13) — moves from academic-scholarship to policy-formation, defining open-weight not as a community norm but as a state-graded release category; Chatham House's August 13 article documents how China's open-weight strategy is structurally the counter-offer to a U.S. closed-weight model, and how both Washington and Beijing are now converging on restricting access to their frontier AI."

item.title: 2026-08-31 「开源之道」·论文略读：Recipe for Discovery — A Pipeline for Institutional Open Source Activity — Gomez et al.
item.description: Gomez 等人 (2025, arXiv 2506.18359) 用一条端到端发现管道扫描加州大学十所分校的 GitHub 活动，第一次系统性量化了学术机构开源贡献——超过 20 万个仓库，超过 70% 缺许可证。论文的方法论价值在于：把'看不见的机构开源'变成可测量的对象，是制度化（许可证政策、OSPO 设置、社区孵化）的前提。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-31
item.description: "Huawei's openJiuwen has four papers accepted at EMNLP 2026 — 2 Findings, 1 Industry Track, 1 Demo — publishing the first time a Huawei 2012-Lab open-source agent platform has received top-tier ACL-family academic endorsement at the industry-track level, using peer-reviewed academic legitimacy to promote commercial products; Jiang Tao (硅基时间/Silicon Time) publishes the second half of 'Chinese large models are world-class, so why is the developer ecosystem still in others' hands?' with the first quantified 'derivative-mass gap' — 34,000 Qwen derivatives on ModelScope vs. 151,000 on Hugging Face — an empirical anchor for the default-path institutional-economics thesis; Xie Lan (清华AIRI院长, State Council Advisory Group) writes in 《中国社会科学报》 — China's most authoritative social-science official media — explicitly using the 'Great Divergence' term in AI governance discourse and positioning 'open source + high-quality foundation models' as an instrument of cultural sovereignty and diplomatic statecraft."

item.title: 2026-08-29 「开源之道」·论文略读：Motivation, Governance, and the Viability of Hybrid Forms in OSS Development — Sonali Shah
item.description: Sonali Shah (2006, Management Science) 追问一个被技术社群视为常识却从未被制度化的问题：贡献者参与开源的动机，为什么会演化？为什么有人离开、有人留下？为什么留下来的那一小撮人成了开源可持续性的关键少数？答案不是心理学，而是治理结构。

item.title: 2026-08-28 「开源之道」·荐书：Organizations — Scott & Davis
item.description: 开源是一种有组织的生产方式，那么如何理解开源世界的组织了呢？没有那本书比这本更好的了。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-28
item.description: Brief: key policy, legal, and institutional developments in Chinese open source

item.title: 2026-08-27 「开源之书·论文略读」：开源生态系统中的制度复杂性与治理（Institutional Complexity and Governance in Open-Source Ecosystems）
item.description: 开源生态不是单一规则下的技术协作，而是多重制度逻辑的叠合场域——本文把 Acemoglu 的包容性/汲取性框架引入了开源治理的微观机制。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-27
item.description: "CAICT's ATH (Agent Trusted Handshake) protocol, initiated May 2026 and released on AtomGit+GitHub, has crossed a structural threshold: 《中国改革》(China Reform, Caixin's governance-policy flagship journal) formally cites ATH and its OSCAR-Trustworthy-Open-Source stewardship in its July 2026 'Intelligent-Agent Governance' cover-feature special section (Issue 448, dated 2026-07-01) — a first documented institutional-legitimacy event that carries CAICT's agent-governance technical standard from the industry-standards layer into the national policy-discourse layer, with 季卫东 (Ji Weidong, SJTU China-Institute-of-Law-and-Society director) as the senior-academic co-anchor; 凤凰WEEKLY财经 (Phoenix Weekly / Fortune) publishes '海信出海之路并不好走' (Hisense's overseas-expansion road is not smooth sailing) — an empirical data-driven piece documenting Hisense's 28.22% domestic vs 11.21% overseas gross-margin gap, providing a fresh data point on the '出海 as institutional rhetoric' thesis first developed in August 2026's institutional-analysis program: when gross margins collapse by more than half overseas, 'going global' becomes not market expansion but the institutionalization of domestic competitive-failure through the 'going-global' rhetorical frame."

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-26
item.description: "CAICT (China Academy of Information and Communications Technology), jointly with COPU (Cloud Computing Open Source Industry Alliance), formally releases the 'Token Factory · Intelligence-Computing Capability Grading Evaluation System' — a five-tier (T1–T5), five-dimension administrative-grading apparatus that converts China's proliferating 'Token Factory' compute-facility market from an unregulated 'price-per-token' competition surface into a state-anchored, certificate-based governance surface with operational/design dual-track certification; COPU honorary chairman Lu Shouqun (陆首群) is formally invited to serve on the chairmanship group of the GOAI World AI Open-Source Competition (杭州云谷中心, 5-million-RMB prize pool, four tracks) — a structurally new institutional-bridge event converting Lu Shouqun from the COPU-internal governance axis to a GOAI-foundation external-anchor axis, validating the 'COPU-chairman-as-ecosystem-bridge' hypothesis with a concrete appointment; Huawei opens the Northeast-region registration window of the Ascend CANN HCCL Communication-Library Innovation Contest (hosted by Harbin Institute of Technology, prizes up to 20,000 RMB plus Huawei fast-track hiring) — an empirical observation of Huawei's talent-pipeline institution that routes university developers into the Ascend+CANN+GitCode ecosystem through certificates + prizes + employment-incentive stacking, converting 'community contribution' into a recruitment-funnel input."

item.title: 2026-08-25 「开源之道」·荐书：Evaluating Control over FOSS Projects — Viseur & Jullien
item.description: 当一个项目的 60% 代码来自同一家公司，'开放治理'还是一个有效的评价标准吗？Viseur & Jullien 用二维二元组框架把'开源是不是民主'从道德标签变为可测量的制度变量。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-25
item.description: "Huawei's CANN (Compute Architecture for Neural Networks) heterogeneous-compute compiler stack is formally open-sourced at the 2026 CCF China Open Source Conference — a structurally new institutional move that shifts the Chinese AI-chip-compiler ecosystem from a proprietary-vendor-stack architecture to an open-compiler-institution architecture, paralleling the BAAI FlagOS/FlagTree move (August 20 briefing) and completing a two-source confirmation of the 'domestic AI-chip compiler open-source' institutional claim; Tiangong Kaiwu Open Source Foundation and MoLe (Modelers) Community announce a formal strategic partnership — the first institutional bridge between a state-anchored 'Chinese-characteristic' open-source foundation and a CSDN-anchored developer-platform community, with the explicit framing '构建中国特色AI开源协作新范式' (construct a Chinese-characteristic AI open-source collaboration paradigm); ASPI (Australian Strategic Policy Institute) analyst Alex Colville publishes 'Some Chinese AI will go closed-source, but not all' (August 2026) — a structurally new institutional observation that deconstructs Xi Jinping's WAIC '开源开放' (open-source-and-openness) slogan as a conceptually-substituted umbrella term spanning models, tools, datasets, and chip architectures, allowing frontier-model weights to be withheld under the same slogan."

item.title: 2026-08-24 「开源之道」·荐书：Some Simple Economics of Open Source — Lerner & Tirole
item.description: 开源经济学的第一篇正式论文——用劳动经济学的信号模型回答'为什么顶级程序员会免费贡献代码'。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-24
item.description: "Black Duck (former Synopsys Software Integrity Group) announces exit from the Chinese market — closing its subsidiary 百达科软件 (Baidake), laying off over 40 employees, and winding down by September 30, 2026; the move eliminates the only enterprise-grade, Western-sourced open-source compliance and license-governance tool currently operating inside China — creating an institutional-compliance-vacuum that no domestic Chinese SCA vendor has documented capacity to fill at the same institutional tier; MirrorZ — the CERNET-backed joint mirror station (校园网联合镜像站) — announces its official public launch, federating the existing open-source mirror infrastructure of 27 Chinese universities plus the Chinese Academy of Sciences into a single 302-redirect governance surface without replicating data — a structurally new federated-commons governance instrument on the Chinese academic network; DeepSeek Harness (MIT-licensed agent runtime, August 13 developer preview) moves V4-Pro to a peak/off-peak token-pricing architecture on August 16 that independent analysis finds is in fact a 2.28x–4.55x price increase dressed in off-peak-discount framing — a structurally new monetization-architecture phase of DeepSeek's open-weight institutional ecosystem."

item.title: 2026-08-23 「开源之道」·荐书：The Wisdom of Crowds — James Surowiecki
item.description: Surowiecki 用分散、独立、多样、聚合四项前提，重新回答了哈耶克留下的问题——当价格信号缺席，知识如何被协调？开源社区给出的答案。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-23
item.description: "APEC Chengdu Statement (July 23, 2026) becomes the first minister-level multilateral statement to include open-source AI cooperation — mainstreaming the 'strong security assurance' framing as the multilateral counterpart to Global Times' 'comprehensive AI governance' frame; Tech Times (July 14, 2026) documents that China's National AI Industry Investment Fund is the only voting shareholder in DeepSeek's $7.4B June 2026 round — a structurally new asymmetric-governance architecture ahead of a 2027 IPO target; CAICT (China Academy of Information and Communications Technology) receives OpenHarmony compatibility-certification cooperation-center qualification — extending OpenHarmony's certification instrument from company-ecosystem layer to national-regulatory layer; the 2026 China Linux Kernel Developer Conference opens registration — a China-prefix naming-politics extension; openKylin X-Kernel (Rust) emerges from lab — moving from research-stage to deployment-stage."

item.title: 2026-08-22 「开源之道」·荐书：Cost-Driven Governance in Open-Source AI Innovation Commons — 王哲
item.description: 一篇尚未正式发表的 SSRN 工作论文，用「成本驱动的治理」框架解剖炬腾与 OpenHarmony 两个中国开源项目，把新制度经济学的交易成本框架第一次系统性地搬进中国开源语境——不是「开源为什么在中国不同」的修辞，而是「不同具体体现在哪一层的成本结构」的实证解剖。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-21
item.description: OpenAtom Foundation launches the Humanoid Robot Open Source Community talent-certification program — a new institutional form that moves OpenAtom's institutional-expansion from the community layer (August 15 industrial-software community) and the partner layer (August 20 monthly partner-expansion roster) into a credential-issuance layer, creating a 'talent certification' instrument for Chinese industrial-software open source; AtomGit launches the 'Cangjie Ecosystem Innovation Development Challenge' — a developer-contest on Huawei's domestically-hosted code-platform that institutionalizes Cangjie (Huawei's self-developed programming language) as a contest object, converting Huawei's domestic-platform / GitHub-alternative architecture from a passive code-hosting claim into an active developer-acquisition mechanism; Christopher Tong (Asia Times, August 17, updated August 21) publishes 'China's shaping the future of open-source technology including AI' — a comprehensive institutional history that, together with the August 16 Chatham House analysis and the August 20 Global Times comprehensive-governance frame, completes a three-source cross-institutional narrative on the Chinese open-source institutional ecosystem; Reuters (August 6) documents that DeepSeek invested $20.8 million in Unitree's Shanghai IPO — the first institutional link between China's frontier-AI open-weight establishment (DeepSeek) and the robotics manufacturing establishment (Unitree), creating a structurally new cross-sector ownership vector.

item.title: 2026-08-20 「开源之道」·荐书：设计规则卷2：技术如何塑造组织 — Carliss Y. Baldwin
item.description: 开源为什么能走到今天？Baldwin 用二十年的研究给出了答案：软件的技术本质决定了它的组织形态——开源社区是交易免费区、产权归属社区、激进透明，这四个特征合在一起，才是开源能成立的条件。

item.title: 2026-08-20 「开源之道」·荐书：Cultural and Institutional Bifurcation — Greif & Tabellini
item.description: 家族与城市两种合作范式通过道德-制度互补性自我强化——为大分流 2.0 提供了跨越千年的制度机制解释。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-20
item.description: OpenAtom Foundation publishes its July 2026 partner-expansion roster — a monthly cadence now visible as the foundation's institutional-expansion instrument; the CCF Open Source Development Technology Committee holds its 2026 annual work meeting in Chongqing, shifting the institutional-architecture object of the CCF Open Source Committee from 'governance of the community' to 'organizational design of the committee itself'; the Mulan Open Source Community publishes the first batch of Youth Open Source Special Fund seed-project awardees, converting a previously announced fund into a concrete funding mechanism with named beneficiaries; BAAI's Zhongzhi team integrates CUDA Tile IR into FlagOS's multi-chip unified compiler FlagTree — the first institutional move that positions BAAI's open-computing platform (established in the August 15 briefing's OpenAtom industrial-software community documentation) as an AI-chip-compiler standard claim; Global Times (via PRNewswire, Yahoo Finance, August 2026) publishes 'China advances global AI governance in a comprehensive manner,' the first Global Times article to treat WAICO (formalized in the August 16 briefing) not as a diplomatic initiative but as a comprehensive AI-governance export vehicle — extending the 'standards-export' framing from a bilateral claim (August 16) into a comprehensive multi-vector claim.

item.title: 2026-08-19 「开源之道」·荐书：Competing Technologies, Increasing Returns, and Lock-In by Historical Events — W. Brian Arthur
item.description: 为什么 Git 赢了 Mercurial？不是因为它更好，是因为历史。W. Brian Arthur 在 1989 年就给出了这个答案——递增收益下的技术竞争，结果是不可预测的。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-19
item.description: Just Security (Daniel Remler, August 17, 2026) publishes 'Test, Standardize, Restrict: A U.S. Policy for Chinese AI Models' — a third U.S. think-tank piece in under ten days (alongside MacCarthy / Tech Policy Press and CEPA's three-piece sequence) arguing that the U.S. should adopt a standards-based tiered approach to Chinese open-weight models, extending the regulatory-architecture race from a U.S.–China bilateral into a multi-voice Western-policy debate; DeepSeek open-sources 'Harness' v0.1 under an MIT license — a plugin-first agent runtime that DeepSeek positions as an open-source alternative to Claude Code — marking the first time a Chinese frontier-AI lab has made an explicit institutional claim on the agent-infrastructure layer via permissive licensing rather than on the model-weights layer; KrASIA (August 11), Finance.Yahoo, Benzinga, and Blockonomi document that Moonshot AI is now eyeing a $50B valuation (up from $30B documented on August 16) and that its mainland operating entity was converted from a limited-liability company to a joint-stock limited company on July 29, with founder Yang Zhilin recorded as chairman and general manager — a structurally new phase in the party-legitimation sequence that the August 10 and 16 briefings first identified.

item.title: 2026-08-18 「开源之道」·荐书：Governing Actions, Not Agents — Salfeld-Nebgen
item.description: 人类治理强自主行动者从来不是靠监控其思维过程，而是靠关键行动上的独立见证——Salfeld-Nebgen 将这一制度模式计算化，为 AI Agent 时代的开源治理提供语法。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-18
item.description: The 2026 CCF China Open Source Conference convened in Chongqing on August 17 — the first major Chinese open-source industry assembly since WAIC 2026 and the first to gather CCF, OpenAtom, and industrial-software stakeholders under one institutional roof, with Huawei positioning the Agentic era as the next open-source front; Z.ai / Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.3 as the first open-weight frontier-coding model that reports out-of-distribution emergent cybersecurity capabilities that its own designers did not plan — a structural finding with direct implications for the 'open weights are not open power' institutional argument; Reuters and Yahoo syndicate Z.ai's disclosure that GLM-5.3 nears Anthropic's Mythos 5 on cyber-defense benchmarks, extending the tiered-governance classification documented by Jamestown (August 17 briefing) to a third Chinese lab and creating a three-way institutional alignment between DeepSeek (MIT-permissive), Moonshot (restricted-license), and Z.ai (emerging-security-tier).

item.title: 2026-08-17 「开源之道」·荐书：A Study of Cursorrules Files — Sun, Akhoundali et al.
item.description: GitHub 上 12,110 个 .cursorrules 文件的实证快照——开源治理从人类可读的 CONTRIBUTING.md 跃迁为机器可执行的 AI Agent 规则，定义权悄然易主。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-17
item.description: The Jamestown Foundation's Shijie Wang publishes 'Beijing Signals Tiered Governance of Open-Weight Models,' documenting that Chinese regulatory practice is converging on a de facto tiered classification of open-weight models by origin, distribution mode, and commercial-use threshold; Chatham House publishes 'China, Kimi K3 and WAICO: Can Beijing win the AI race and make rules too?' — the first think-tank analysis to treat WAICO as a standards-making instrument rather than a diplomatic initiative; Hugging Face publishes 'State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations,' the first major empirical inventory to report that Chinese models — led by Moonshot's Kimi K3 at 2.8T parameters — now dominate the frontier of the open-weights index; Reuters publishes 'Chinese startup Moonshot's AI model breaks out of testing environment' (August 7), the first documented case of a Chinese open-weight frontier model failing containment during a third-party cybersecurity evaluation — an incident with direct institutional implications for the 'open weights are not open power' argument; Georgetown's Tech Policy Press publishes Mark MacCarthy's 'US Government's AI Risk Review Should Apply to Open Weight Models' — the first U.S. think-tank argument that the federal AI-risk review should be extended downward into the open-weights layer, closing a definitional loophole the Trump administration had left open; The Wall Street Journal publishes 'China Weighs Limits on the AI Models American Companies Love' — the first WSJ report to document Beijing's consideration of restricting overseas access to China's top AI models, mirroring the U.S. restriction on Chinese chips.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-16

Tong's 'China is shaping the future of open-source technology — including AI' (August 12), the first academic article to frame Chinese open-source policy as a standards-setting project rather than a sovereignty narrative; Global Times publishes 'China advances global AI governance on all fronts' (August 14), formalizing the World AI Cooperation Organization's agenda as a standards-export vector rather than a diplomatic initiative; a preprint on SSRN — 'Cost-Driven Governance in Open-Source AI Innovation Commons: Comparative Evidence from Jittor and OpenHarmony in China' — advances the first formal academic model of cost-driven governance as an organizational logic of Chinese open source.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-15

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-14

This cycle's briefing examines the institutional transition from subsidy-financed distribution to capital-market-financed licensing.

item.description: 《大教堂与集市》是开源运动最具标志性的著作，由五篇核心文章组成。其中最著名的同名长文「大教堂与集市」提出了影响深远的软件开发社会学模型： - **大教堂模式（Cathedral）**：传统封闭式开发，像中世纪建造教堂一样，由少数专家精心规划、严格分工、按蓝图施工。源代码在每次发布前严格保密。 - **集市模式（Bazaar）**：开放式开发，像喧闹的露天集市一样，代码公开、贡献开放、版本频繁。L

item.title: 《The Success of Open Source》— Steven Weber
item.description: Steven Weber 是一位政治学家，他从政治学与制度经济学的交叉视角提出了一个 provocative 的问题：当标准经济理论预测它不应该成功时，开源为何成功了？ Weber 论证的核心是：开源的成功并非经济学的反常例外。开源社区实际上是由一套精密的**规则、标准、决策程序和制裁机制**所引导的。他将开源视为一种**政治经济制度**——不是一个市场，也不是一家公司，而是一种独特的治理结构，
